title: Hiding skills and commands unless a certain TP threshold is met.

posts.author: Kurbbie
posts.body:
Hello, I'm looking to replicate the limit break system from the FF series. FF7 specifically. So I have the skills and balancing all setup and preserve TP. Is there a way without a plugin to hide the skill and command its listed under unless the certain condition is met? Such as my skill type is "Limit" and the skill is "Sharpshooters Fury" TP required 100 but isnt listed in the command list or skill list unless TP is 100 then the "Limit" command will appear?
Thanks in advance I dunno if I'm able to explain it better

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
No, not well.
The only thing you could do is put a troop event into every troop that runs at the end of every turn.
It would check each actor for whatever your condition is, and if it's true, give them a state with Add Skill Type for Limit; if false, remove that state.
But, obviously, that would only take effect at the end of each turn so if your actor gets damage and fills their limit gauge before they enter their action, it wouldn't show up until the next turn.
And you'd have to copy and paste that page into every troop in your game.
I'm not sure why you specify "without a plugin," because it's pretty simple to do with one.

So:
Code:
<Action Respond Eval>
if (target.tp == 100)
    target.addState(42);
else
    target.removeState(42);
</Action Respond Eval>
where 42 is the state that has Add Skill Type: Limit in its Traits.

posts.author: CrocPirate
posts.body:
I'm doing something similar in my game. Here's how you hide the Limit Break command until the Actor reach 100 TP:
First, I suggest you make TWO Skill Types called Limit Break (Mine is called Blitz). Then in the SkillsStatesCore plugin, under Skill Settings parameters, make sure you hide one of the Limit Skill Type command during Battle. (For me is 10.) The reason for this is so that the player can see what Limit Breaks they have in the Skills Menu:
Next, for your Limit Break skills, make sure that the skill type is one of the Limit Break Skill Type and use the notetags:
Code:
<Skill Types: x,y>
<TP Cost: 100%>
Replace x with the ID of the 1st Limit Break skill type and y with the 2nd Limit Break skill type.
Furthermore, the reason why I'm suggesting you use the <TP Cost: 100%> for these skills, is just in case you want to change how much TP an Actor has using the EnhancedTPSystem plugin. (Like changing it from 100 to 255, for example.) The Limit Break skill will always use 100% of the Actor's TP.
Here's an example:
Finally, you will need to create a passive state.
In the Traits section of the state, use Add Skill Type to add the Limit Break Command that IS NOT hidden with the SkillsStatesCore plugin.
Then in the Notes of the State, add this:
Code:
<Bypass Combat Log>
<Hide State Popup>
<Exclude From Tooltips>


<JS Passive Condition>
condition = (user.tp === user.maxTp());
</JS Passive Condition>
The state has no icon and the priority is 1. This is what it looks like:
Finally, in the SkillsStatesCore plugin, under the Passive States Parameters, in the Actors-Only Passives, enter the ID of the Limit Break state. (For me, it's 240)
And that's it!
